description: This PHP source file defines the PimReportDataAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, which extends ReportDataAPI to handle API requests related to PIM reports. It includes methods for retrieving report generator services, validating request parameters, and fetching specific report instances based on request data.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class handling PIM report data retrieval, including report validation and report object instantiation based on request parameters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the appropriate report object based on the report name and request parameters; throws BadRequestException for invalid report names.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Sets up and returns validation rules for the 'get all' reports request, ensuring report ID is positive and valid.
